purpose: Git-tracked derived low/mid-only free fit used as the reference optimum for transfer-parameter identifiability profiling

provenance.note: Diagnostic-only low/mid optimum. Large out-of-band parameter motion in this fit motivates fixed-parameter profiles rather than physical interpretation.

guardrail: The free-fit parameter values are not hardware identifications. They are retained only as a numerical reference for profile likelihood-style diagnostics.
